_comment: Single source of truth for macro indicators (Plan A Tier 1). NOT YET wired into index.html render — see PLAN-macro-json.md for remaining steps. Each value carries a 'source' = the FRED / Trading Economics series ID it will auto-fetch from in Tier 2.

us10y.label: US 10Y Treasury
us10y.note: dropped to ~4.60% Friday after another soft jobs read firmed up Sept-cut bets; Jackson Hole (late Aug) is still the next big signal

fedFunds.label: Fed Funds Rate
fedFunds.note: July NFP +22K (vs +75K exp.), unemployment 4.3% (highest since Oct 2021) — weak print firms up Sept-cut odds ahead of Jackson Hole

usCPI.label: US CPI (YoY)
usCPI.note: disinflation resuming off May's 4.2%; supports easing

usPCE.label: US PCE (YoY)
usPCE.note: cooled vs prior; supports the easing-path tone

dxy.label: Dollar Index (DXY)
dxy.note: holding near 99.6–99.9, firmer than the soft-dollar case despite falling yields; a break back below 98 is what would broaden EM/commodity relief

source.caveat: DXY proper is ICE; DTWEXBGS is FRED's broad trade-weighted USD index — close proxy, label accordingly

biRate.label: Bank Indonesia Rate
biRate.note: rupiah holding firmer, foreign inflows returning, IDX recovery matured

usdidr.label: USD/IDR
usdidr.note: rupiah holding firmer as the hike takes hold; sub-17,200 = stress clearing

gold.label: Gold (XAU)
gold.note: jumped over 2% Friday to $4,340–4,370 (highest since mid-June), +~7% on the week — the same soft jobs print pulling forward Fed rate-cut bets is driving the haven bid

source.caveat: no free FRED/TE daily series; keep manual or use a market-data API in a later tier

wti.label: WTI Crude
wti.delta: steadied, still down on the wk
wti.note: bounced ~1% Friday to $78 but still down over 7% this week after the Iran–Oman Hormuz shipping deal eased supply risk
